parse_acpc_line: parse a single ACPC hand history log line into a Hand object with events, cards, and profits
render_pokersite: render a parsed Hand object into a poker site formatted hand history string with showdown and summary
tokenize_actions: tokenize a single street action string into a tuple of check, fold, and raise tokens with amounts
Config: create a Config dataclass to specify poker game parameters like seats, blinds, antes, and starting stacks
Event_ps_text: generate a poker site text representation of a single hand event like bet, raise, call, check, or fold
